changes.summary: 1) Added _get_clean_navigation_url(url) returning the preserved URL intact, eliminating unconditional rewrite to blocked fallback search URL. 2) Updated _extract_products_from_html to recognize official store showcase carousels (ui-ms-section-eshops, home--seller, ui-ms-polycard-carousel), preventing legitimate store poly-cards from being discarded. 3) Made vendor fallback resolution dynamic via tienda regex from URL instead of hardcoding 'Nicopoly'.
Enforced headless=True strictly for Mercado Libre per AGENTS.md Rule 1, leaving only Ripley with non-headless authorization for Cloudflare Turnstile.
